screening.reason: Exclusion 3: uses only structural T1-weighted MRI morphological features from ABIDE I, no resting-state functional analysis; additionally the cohort is restricted to typically-developing individuals only (no ASD group, no autism-vs-control analysis, no diagnostic prediction of autism) — the task is brain-age regression, not an ASD-relevant claim.

evidence_quotes: we selected T = 378 T1-weighted MRI publicly available scans of a cohort of typically-developing individuals from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I) collected from 17 international sites.
